description.zh:
手机号：
- paramType 传 normal 时：传入手机号明文。
- paramType 传 md5 时：传入手机号密文。
description.en:
The mobile phone number. Valid values:
- If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the mobile phone number in plaintext.
- If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted mobile phone number.

description.zh:
加密方式：
- normal：明文不加密
- md5：MD5加密
description.en:
The encryption method. Valid values:
- normal: plaintext without encryption
- md5: MD5 encryption.

description.zh:
姓名：
- paramType 传 normal 时：传入姓名明文。
- paramType 传 md5 时：传入姓名密文。
description.en:
The name. Valid values:
- If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the name in plaintext.
- If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted name.

descriptions.zh: 传入手机号、姓名，通过权威数据源验证其真实性和一致性。
descriptions.en: Passes in a mobile phone number and a name, and verifies their authenticity and consistency through an authoritative data source.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth mobile-2-meta-verify --param-type normal --user-name '●_明文：张三_●_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --mobile '●_明文：18600002055_●_密文：_849169cd3b20621c1c78bd61a11a4fc2' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth Mobile2MetaVerify --region cn-hangzhou --UserName '●_明文：张三_●_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --Mobile '●_明文：18600002055_●_密文：_849169cd3b20621c1c78bd61a11a4fc2' --ParamType normal
